*Originally shared on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7467590474732740609/).*

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[Download the PDF](db2pq-r-on-cran.pdf).
:::

The R version of my `db2pq` package is now available on [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=db2pq). This package turns PostgreSQL tables (such as those provided by WRDS) into Parquet files for fast, memory-efficient data analysis with packages like DuckDB or Python Polars.

[`db2pq` documentation](https://iangow.github.io/db2pqr/)
